description: Searches for videos on YouTube. Group: YouTube-Search. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

features.description: A comma-separated list of video features to filter by. Allowed values: 360, 3d, 4k, creative_commons, hd, hdr, live, location, purchased, subtitles, vr180.

nextToken.description: A token for paginating to the next set of results.

prioritize.description: Prioritize results by relevance or popularity.

sortBy.description: DEPRECATED: The sort order for search results. Please use 'prioritize' and 'uploadDate' instead. Allowed values: relevance, rating, upload_date, view_count.

name: get_youtube_v3_search_video
title: Search Videos
